definition: Eureka Robotics is a Singaporean robotics and machine vision company that develops AI vision systems for bin picking and vision-guided robotics in manufacturing automation.
details: Its systems combine a 3D camera, a controller and software, and are also applied to machine tending and precision assembly tasks. The company was founded in 2018 as a spin-off from Nanyang Technological University (NTU) in Singapore and has offices in Singapore and Tokyo.

explainer.lead: Eureka Robotics is a Singaporean company that builds AI vision systems to help industrial robots see and handle objects. Its technology aims to make tasks such as picking parts from bins and assembling precise components easier to automate.

tiers.eli5: Eureka Robotics gives factory robots something like eyes and a brain. A special camera helps a robot understand where objects are, so it can pick up the right part or help put pieces together.
tiers.practitioner: Its systems combine a 3D camera, a controller and software for vision-guided robotics. They are applied to bin picking, machine tending and precision assembly in manufacturing automation.
tiers.paperLevel: Eureka Robotics is an organization developing AI-based machine-vision systems for vision-guided robotic manipulation. Its system-level formulation combines 3D sensing, control hardware and software for manufacturing tasks including bin picking, machine tending and precision assembly.

explainer.example: In a factory bin-picking task, the system’s 3D camera views the parts, and its controller and software guide a vision-equipped robot to pick a part from the bin.
